Age.description: Countdown in ticks before entity become adult.

Air.description: Countdown in ticks before entity start drowning.

Armor.description: Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots. Accessible by index, not marked with `Slot` property.

AttackTime.description: Last attack tick, determines time between attacks.

BodyRot.description: Entity body yaw rotation in degrees, with offset of .

Dead.description: Entity is dead, which is required to visualize animation of dying.

FallDistance.description: Last synchronized distance between ground and entity.

Fire.description: Fire ticks before burning stopped, alternative of .

HurtTime.description: Last hurt tick, determines entity panic/attack state.

Invulnerable.description: Immune to in-game damage types, such as NPCs and Agents.

IsAngry.description: Normally, entity become angry when attacked.

IsBaby.description: Entity is not adult, so when  reaches `0` it is not baby.

IsEating.description: Entity is eating  item, displays particles around.

IsIllagerCaptain.description: Patrols of pillagers following their leader.

IsPregnant.description: Entity breeded and prepared to duplicate itself, such as turtles.

IsScared.description: Entity sees dangerous thing around, such as villagers flee.

IsTamed.description: Entity is tamed, such as cats or dogs.

IsTrusting.description:
Entity is trusting player (do not panic when it came),
such as foxes childs breeded by someone.

LastDimensionId.description:
Dimension from entity transfered when is going to portal,
last saved state when loaded into dimension.

LootDropped.description: Required on first death tick, drops loot again if set to `false`.

Mainhand.description: Item set by , entities uses it for attack and other AI-related things.

Motion.description: Velocity of physics in-world, vector of moving target.

NaturalSpawn.description: Entity is naturally spawned, not breeded or summoned.

Offhand.description: Item set by , in common cases entities ignores it, but players or extra-powered items (Totem of Undying fully restores non-player entities health) are useful.

PortalCooldown.description: Ticks before entity can move through portal again.

Rotation.description: Yaw (horizontal rotation angle) and pitch (vertical rotation angle) respectively in degrees, alternative of .

Saddled.description: When pig or strider is saddled (excludes horses or not?).

Sheared.description: When sheep or snow golem is sheared.

Sitting.description: Entity is sitting, such as players or foxes.

TargetID.description: Following, attacking or anything else targeted entity.

TimeStamp.description: Tick when entity is born, used to  property.

UniqueID.description: Entity UID, which is passed to Inner Core callbacks.

canPickupItems.description: Entity may equip, take or replace containing item from drop.

definitions.description:
Set of rules applied (starts with `+`) or excluded (starts with `-`)
from entity; it includes properties, tasks, etc.

identifier.description: Typed entity identifier without tags, such as `"minecraft:cow"`.
